question: What is the primary goal of quality care in reproductive health?

options.A: To increase the total number of hospital beds
options.B: To reduce the cost of running the pharmacy
options.C: To shorten the working hours for midwives
options.D: To prevent maternal and newborn complications

explanation: Quality care focuses heavily on keeping mothers and newborns safe from preventable harm during pregnancy and childbirth. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h1)

question: Why is patient-centered care an important part of reproductive health quality?

options.A: It allows patients to prescribe their own medications
options.B: It ensures mothers are treated with respect and dignity
options.C: It guarantees that hospital bills will be fully waived
options.D: It removes the need for nurses to write care plans

explanation: Patient-centered care honors the values and preferences of the mother, ensuring she feels heard, respected, and safe throughout her care. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h1)

question: What is the main purpose of a clinical guideline in nursing?

options.A: To punish nurses who make minor documentation errors
options.B: To help nurses make evidence-based care decisions
options.C: To increase the cost of hospital equipment purchasing
options.D: To replace doctors completely in the labor room

explanation: Guidelines provide clear, research-backed instructions so nurses know the best steps to take for specific health problems. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h2)

question: A maternity ward protocol for treating postpartum hemorrhage is best described as what?

options.A: A personal opinion written by a senior ward nurse
options.B: A financial document used to balance hospital accounts
options.C: A step-by-step instruction for managing heavy bleeding
options.D: A general suggestion that staff can ignore anytime

explanation: Protocols give exact, sequential actions for managing emergency situations like bleeding after birth. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h2)

question: What is the main purpose of a clinical audit in a healthcare facility?

options.A: To count the total number of visitors in the ward
options.B: To check how much money patients spent on drugs
options.C: To punish nurses who arrive late for morning shift
options.D: To compare current nursing care against set standards

explanation: An audit looks at real patient records to see if the care given matches the approved guidelines and standards. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h3)

question: A hospital audit reveals that half of all postpartum women did not receive timely blood pressure checks. What is the most appropriate next step?

options.A: Hide the report so the hospital management does not get angry
options.B: Share the feedback with the nurses and retrain staff on monitoring
options.C: Blame individual patients for refusing their vital signs checks
options.D: Stop taking blood pressures entirely to save nursing time

explanation: Audit results must be used to provide feedback and education to correct gaps in clinical practice. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h3)

question: What is the main focus of a Root Cause Analysis (RCA) after an adverse event?

options.A: Finding the underlying system failures that caused the error
options.B: Writing a quick note in the patient file and forgetting it
options.C: Deciding how much money the patient should pay in fines
options.D: Finding the single nurse to blame for the bad outcome

explanation: RCA looks beyond the individual worker to fix broken processes and prevent future accidents. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h4)

question: Why must adverse event reporting systems in hospitals be non-punitive?

options.A: To encourage staff to report mistakes without fear of harsh punishment
options.B: To allow doctors to bypass hospital management rules freely
options.C: To ensure that nurses never have to document anything in writing
options.D: To reduce the need for buying emergency resuscitation equipment

explanation: If staff fear punishment, they will hide errors instead of reporting them, preventing the hospital from learning and improving safety. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h4)

question: What is the primary purpose of using a surgical safety checklist in the labor ward?

options.A: To slow down emergency cesarean sections unnecessarily
options.B: To give doctors extra paperwork to fill out after work
options.C: To make sure vital safety steps are never skipped during care
options.D: To replace the need for professional nursing judgment

explanation: Checklists act as a memory aid to ensure critical safety checks are completed before, during, and after procedures. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h5)

question: A nurse is preparing a patient for an emergency cesarean section in a busy unit. What is the best way to use the safety checklist?

options.A: Pause and verify each safety step out loud with the surgical team
options.B: Ignore the checklist because the team is in a hurry to save time
options.C: Ask the patient to fill out the surgical checklist by herself
options.D: Sign the checklist at the end of the shift without checking the patient

explanation: Checklists are most effective when the healthcare team pauses to verify items collaboratively out loud before proceeding. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h5)

question: What does the letter 'P' stand for in the PDSA cycle used for quality improvement?
explanation: In the PDSA cycle, Plan refers to identifying the problem and planning a small change to test. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h6)

question: Why is Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI) described as an ongoing cycle rather than a single event?

options.A: Because medical equipment never breaks down more than once
options.B: Because hospital management loves writing endless reports every week
options.C: Because healthcare delivery and patient needs are always changing
options.D: Because nurses have too much free time during their shifts

explanation: CQI is continuous because healthcare environments are dynamic, requiring constant monitoring and small adjustments to maintain high standards. [learn more](GNS312_U5_T3#GNS312_U5_T3_h6)
